prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this Tibetan local government courtyard sprite. Preserve its realistic Tibetan white and ochre stone architecture, flat roofs, black window surrounds, dark red wood, quiet courtyard, upper-left light and details. Remove COMPLETELY the broad dusty beige ambient glow outside the building. The previous outside halo is unacceptable. All empty pixels around the thin ground contact polygon must have alpha=0, no beige halo, no fog or backdrop and no big cast shadow. Give crisp natural antialiased silhouette like a clean game cutout. Building remains opaque. Make front-left ground edge longer so its ratio to front-right edge is 16:12 = 1.333. Both axes +0.5/-0.5 exactly. On a 1536x1024 canvas foot contact corners are LEFT (168,520), FRONT (853.7,862.9), RIGHT (1368,605.7), BACK (682.3,262.9). Match all walls to these corners and keep opposite edges parallel. Main entrance on front-left edge. Keep all silhouette edges and roof inside canvas with at least 40px true transparent margin. Thin stone contact patch only, no thick base, no text, no grid, no people, no symbols, no watermark. Single finished transparent RGBA sprite.
